provider: Selectel Object Storage (Russia) — coldest tier is cheap, the traffic is not

free_tier.stated: Ice (ледяное) ₽0.89/GB/mo; Cold ₽1.26/GB/mo; Standard ₽2.57/GB/mo. Volume ladder: up to 10 TB ₽1.35, 10-50 TB ₽1.31, 50 TB+ lower (per Selectel's own price-change digest).

egress.terms: METERED at ₽1.96/GB on every class, plus paid requests — Ice requests are the most expensive in the set at ₽361 per 1 M GET/HEAD and ₽3,009 per 1 M PUT (`serverdelo.ru` table, prices verified 2026-10-03). This is the trap: the cheapest storage line in Russia pairs with the most expensive retrieval. Selectel's OWN promotional tariff does waive it — «не платите за исходящий трафик и запросы весь год» — but only at ₽2/GB storage plus a ₽10,000/month platform fee, i.e. you prepay ₽120,000/yr to buy out the egress.

tooling: S3-compatible with IAM, S3 endpoint live (`https://s3.ru-7.storage.selcloud.ru/` -> 403 for anonymous list, expected). rclone `s3`, aws-cli, Terraform.
chaining: Volume ladder is shallow (₽1.35 → ₽1.31 from 10 TB to 50 TB, a 3 % step) — no meaningful economy of scale.
limits_note: Ice has a minimum storage duration and retrieval billing, so short-lived objects cost double. Requests are billed per million and Ice's GET rate of ₽361/M makes any small-object workload (a 20 TiB corpus of 1 MB shards = 20 M GETs) cost $87 in requests per full pass on top of storage.
reliability_note: Tier-1 Russian provider, 152-FZ/PCI DSS/ISO 27001/27017/27018, three copies across racks. No reliability concern; the concern is purely the egress and per-request structure.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

extras.price_verbatim: Ice: $11.04/TB/mo storage PLUS $24.31/TB for every full read-back (₽1.96/GB × 1024) — so one complete retrieval costs 2.2 months of storage. Realistic cold-archive usage (store 1 TB, read 250 GB per month): $11.04 + $6.08 = $17.12/TB/mo. At 50 % monthly read: $23.19/TB/mo. Identical at 5 TB and 20 TB because storage is per-GB with only a 3 % volume step (₽1.35 → ₽1.31 above 10 TB). Standard class: $31.87/TB/mo storage + $17.11/TB per read-back. Ice request billing is the harsher trap for small objects: ₽361 per 1 M GET/HEAD = $4.37 per million, so a 20 TiB corpus of 1 MB shards (20 M GETs) incurs $87 in requests alone per full pass.
